hero.badge: Official Portal of Polytechnic LP3I Student KPU
hero.desc: Welcome to the official information portal for the Student General Election of Polytechnic LP3I. Get to know your leaders, learn the voting procedures, and cast your vote wisely.

timeline.title: Stages of Student General Election
timeline.desc: All events are conducted transparently, in a structured manner, and with accountability for democratic succession of BEM LP3I.
timeline.step1_desc: Announcement of candidacy requirements and registration of candidate pairs.
timeline.step2_desc: Verification of administrative documents and plenary meeting for ballot number drawing.
timeline.step3_desc: Presentation of vision, mission, and open debate before the entire academic community of LP3I.
timeline.step4_desc: Direct voting in voting booths and transparent vote counting by the KPU committee.

timeline_kpu.title: KPU 2026 Activity Timeline
timeline_kpu.desc: Timeline of events from candidate registration to voting day of Polytechnic LP3I Student Election.
timeline_kpu.t1_desc: Registration of Student President and Vice President Candidate Pairs.
timeline_kpu.t2_desc: Socialization meeting with Program Heads and Student Presidential Candidates.
timeline_kpu.t3_desc: Initial interview stage for registered presidential and vice presidential candidate pairs.
timeline_kpu.t4_desc: Socialization of student general election to faculty and lecturers of Polytechnic LP3I.
timeline_kpu.t5_desc: In-depth interview on vision commitment and organizational leadership readiness.
timeline_kpu.t6_desc: Closed debate among candidate pairs before independent assessment panelists.
timeline_kpu.t7_desc: Public debate and vision presentation before all students of Polytechnic LP3I.
timeline_kpu.t8_desc: Official E-Voting day and vote counting to elect the next Student President.

voting.title: Student Election Voting
voting.subtitle: Cast your vote honestly, fairly, confidentially, and directly through the integrated e-voting system of Polytechnic LP3I Student KPU.
voting.steps_sub: Make sure you have your official Voting Code from the Student KPU Committee.
voting.step1_desc: Enter your Student ID (NIM) and 6-character unique Voting Code provided by KPU.
voting.step2_desc: Select your desired candidate pair on the digital ballot in the confidential booth.
voting.step3_desc: Confirm your choice until a digital voting receipt appears on screen.

tutorial.notice_text: Notice: The process and steps in Simulation mode and Official Voting are completely identical.
tutorial.step1_desc: Enter your official Student ID (NIM) and secret Voting Token Code issued by the Election Committee.
tutorial.step1_point1: Type your registered Student ID (NIM) or Unique ID listed in the voter directory.
tutorial.step1_point2: Enter the secret voting token code verified by the committee (auto-filled in simulation mode).
tutorial.step1_point3: Check the voting booth status and the countdown timer before the booth closes.
tutorial.step1_point4: Press 'Enter Voting Booth' to proceed to the candidate selection stage.
tutorial.step2_desc: Compare profiles, vision, mission statements, and flagship programs before making your selection.
tutorial.step2_point1: Use navigation arrows or swipe across the screen to explore all candidate pairs.
tutorial.step2_point2: Check candidate official photos, full names of candidates, and their study programs.
tutorial.step2_point3: Click 'Enlarge Detail' to read comprehensive vision, mission, and work program descriptions.
tutorial.step2_point4: Once you are confident with your candidate choice, click the 'Choose Candidate' button.
tutorial.step3_desc: The system presents a confirmation dialog to guarantee you do not accidentally vote for the wrong candidate.
tutorial.step3_point1: Double-check the ballot number and candidate names shown in the confirmation prompt.
tutorial.step3_point2: Ensure your selection aligns with your conscience and deliberate decision.
tutorial.step3_point3: Click 'Cancel' if you wish to adjust your vote and select a different candidate pair.
tutorial.step3_point4: Click 'Yes, Continue' to submit and permanently register your vote in the system.
tutorial.step4_desc: Your vote has been safely and anonymously recorded in the election tally system.
tutorial.step4_point1: A confirmation screen certifies that your ballot has been successfully stored.
tutorial.step4_point2: Each voter account is restricted to a single submission to safeguard election integrity.
tutorial.step4_point3: In simulation mode, you can click 'Repeat Simulation' anytime to practice again.
tutorial.step4_point4: Click 'Back to Home' to conclude your voting session securely.
tutorial.step5_desc: Watch the video demonstration of the electronic ballot booth for a complete visual walkthrough.
tutorial.step5_point1: Watch the interactive electronic booth demonstration video above carefully.
tutorial.step5_point2: The video shows the full real-life procedure from credential verification to ballot confirmation.
tutorial.step5_point3: If the video player is restricted, click 'Open Video in New Tab' to view it directly.
tutorial.step5_point4: Click the 'Finish & Close' button below to close the guide and begin voting.
